scope: Relationship between the committed source tree and every result artifact in this repository.
summary: Two source repairs landed after every training run and every evaluation in this repository had already been produced. The repairs are correct and are retained. The consequence is that the committed source does not bit-exactly regenerate the committed numbers, and that fact is disclosed here rather than hidden behind a regenerated provenance file.

repairs.why: SAMPLE was declared feasible without accounting for the unavoidable sleep and proxy-monitor draw charged in the same step, so a sample could be admitted that drove the battery below zero once all same-step costs were applied.
repairs.propagation: MultiAgentSensorEnv composes SingleAgentSensorEnv and delegates get_action_mask, and pettingzoo_env wraps MultiAgentSensorEnv, so the rule governs the action mask and sample execution for every agent in every training run and every evaluation.
repairs.affects: All results produced before 2026-08-19T21:28:39Z, which is all of them.

measured_impact_headline.probe_policy: request SAMPLE whenever the mask allows it (upper bound on disagreement)

repairs.interpretation: The two rules can only disagree while the battery sits inside a 0.017%-wide band. Under the policy that saturates that band, the mean per-episode reward moves by less than 0.2 units and the worst single seed by 4.2 units, against a headline Extended-versus-Improved effect of 27.67 units with a bootstrap interval of [23.27, 32.31]. No reported comparison changes sign or loses significance. The results are therefore disclosed, not invalidated.

repairs.repair: load_models now copies the restored mixer into target_mixer, and reapplies args.lr after Optimizer.load_state_dict.
repairs.why: Upstream EPyMARL restores target_mac from the online weights but leaves target_mixer at its fresh random initialisation, so a warm-started QMIX learner bootstraps its first TD targets from an untrained mixing network.
repairs.why_unrecoverable: All runs were launched from a disclosed dirty worktree. The run manifests recorded git_sha and a dirty flag but no hash of the learner source, so the file's single modification timestamp cannot separate the target-mixer edit from the later learning-rate edit in the same file.
repairs.indirect_evidence: An unsynchronised target mixer perturbs the TD target by roughly 4.1 reward units on average (max 12.3) at this Q scale. The Extended seed-101 continuation logs its first post-resume loss as 4.24, below both the source run's terminal 4.606 and its own median 4.572, with no spike at the resume boundary. This is consistent with the synchronisation already being present during the Extended runs, but it is evidence, not proof.
repairs.remediation: training/train_all.py now records training_source_sha256 over the learner, controller, runner, agent, mixer, launcher, profile, and gate sources, so future runs identify their own training semantics without relying on file modification times.

config_digest_drift.reason: training/sanity_checks.py config_digest was strengthened to close a dependency gap; it now covers episode length, event-proxy parameters, the energy profile, the sample-feasibility contract, and SHA-256 of the four environment source files.
config_digest_drift.verification: Applying the pre-repair digest formula to the current shared_config values reproduces both recorded legacy digests exactly, so no shared_config value changed. The digest flip is entirely attributable to the strengthened formula plus the environment source repair.

consequence_for_the_corrected_low_lr_exp.detail: training/train_all.py resolves a resume checkpoint only among manifest entries whose config_digest equals the current gate digest. The Extended manifests record the legacy digest, so a refined warm-start from Extended now raises RuntimeError for all three seeds. This guard is behaving correctly: it refuses to continue training from checkpoints produced under a different environment contract.
consequence_for_the_corrected_low_lr_exp.requirement: A corrected low-learning-rate experiment therefore needs more than fresh selection and final seeds. It needs Extended checkpoints retrained under the repaired environment, or an explicit and separately recorded decision to warm-start across the environment repair.
consequence_for_the_corrected_low_lr_exp.must_not: The digest guard must not be bypassed silently to make the resume succeed.

not_affected: shared_config values, which are byte-identical to the versions used by every run
the seed partitions and split-lock records
the consumed status of the v2, v3, and v4 final splits
the v4 protocol invalidation, which stands on its own separate learning-rate evidence
